seo.title: The Vehicle — Eternal Repos
seo.description: How we carry your loved one, gently — a calm, private space that shields your family and honours the one you’ve lost.

hero.body: A calm, private space that shields your family from public view and carries the one you've lost with quiet dignity — unhurried, and safe.

closerLook.heading: Considered from every angle.
closerLook.body: Every line is drawn for calm and discretion — a quiet presence on the road, and a gentle space within.

highlights.heading: Every detail, chosen for calm.
highlights.body: Not a specification sheet — three quiet things a family feels the moment the doors close.

items.title: Quiet, all the way
items.description: Soft, sound-insulated interiors keep the world outside, so the journey stays still and unhurried.

items.title: Warm, unhurried light
items.description: Gentle warm light, and room for flowers and family — a space that feels held, never clinical.

items.title: Clean, and cared for
items.description: Immaculately kept and gently climate-controlled, so everything feels calm, fresh and dignified.

specs.heading: For those who'd like the details.
specs.body: Everything below is here for anyone who wants to look closer — there's no need to, unless you'd like to.

specs.label: Chassis Platform Reference
specs.value: Wide-body commercial chassis (Force Urbania / Tempo Traveller XL wide chassis base)

specs.label: Wheelbase
specs.value: 3,610 mm wide stance for enhanced lateral stability

specs.label: Turning Radius
specs.value: 6.3 meters tailored for urban ceremonial access

specs.label: Acoustic Dampening
specs.value: Multi-layer butyl rubber sound deadening + 30mm acoustic felt insulation

specs.label: Ambient Lighting
specs.value: Hidden dimmable 2700K warm LED linear cove with soft mood diffuser

specs.label: Wall & Ceiling Finish
specs.value: Soft-touch matte seamless leatherette with warm walnut woodgrain accents

specs.label: Seating Configuration
specs.value: 4–6 ergonomic attendant seats with high-density foam & leatherette upholstery

specs.label: Bier Platform Mechanism
specs.value: Precision multi-stage electro-hydraulic lift platform with soft landing stop

specs.label: Locking Systems
specs.value: Dual electromagnetic bier locks + mechanical safety pin latch

specs.label: Floral Retention
specs.value: Integrated perimeter flower wreath mounting brackets & stainless clips

specs.label: Viewing Glass
specs.value: Laminated acoustic double-glazed viewing bay with subtle privacy tint

specs.label: Rear AC System
specs.value: Independent 14,000 BTU dual-evaporator rear climate system

specs.label: Air Purification
specs.value: HEPA H13 filtration + active carbon odor neutralization

specs.label: Hygiene Surfacing
specs.value: Hospital-grade antimicrobial interior paneling + seamless washable floor seal

specs.label: Sanitation System
specs.value: Pre-wired for automated UV-C sanitation cycle between trips

specs.label: Auxiliary Power Unit
specs.value: 12V 200Ah Lithium LiFePO4 auxiliary battery bank

specs.label: Inverter System
specs.value: 2000W pure sine wave quiet inverter for medical & cooling gear

specs.label: Audio Integration
specs.value: Multi-zone Bluetooth acoustic sound system tuned for ambient soundscapes

specs.label: Digital Display
specs.value: 10-inch discreet ceremonial information console

downloadCta.heading: Would you like the full details?
downloadCta.body: We're glad to share the complete details for your family or your organisation — download them here, or simply ask us.

verse.text: The last journey should be as gentle as the life it carries.
